# Bologna Institute for Policy Research (BIPR)

> > The Bologna Institute for Policy Research (BIPR) at Johns Hopkins SAIS Europe conducts interdisciplinary policy research and academic programs in Bologna, Italy.

BIPR serves as the research hub for SAIS Europe, hosting initiatives like the Human Trafficking Initiative (HTI), providing teaching assistant opportunities for doctoral students, and publishing policy analysis on global issues including Iran, European integration, and regional security.
